name: Costume & Prop Construction
description: Physical props and attire are the material layer of social engineering. A hi-vis vest and hard hat transforms an unknown visitor into an expected contractor. A clipboard with official-looking paperwork provides behavioral cover while moving through a facility. Props must be appropriate to the pretext, accurate enough to withstand casual inspection, and practical enough not to impede the operational objective. Prop sourcing should be done well in advance — never show up with a prop you have not practiced carrying naturally.

blue.det: Security staff noticing inconsistencies in attire or props; wrong logo, incorrect uniform style, props not matching stated role; visitor log discrepancies.
blue.cm: Security awareness training on uniform and credential verification; challenge culture; visitor escort policy; photo ID requirement for all visitors regardless of attire.
